description.value: Cora is a well-known Canadian breakfast and lunch franchise chain with a Kelowna outpost inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre. The menu leans heavily on fresh fruit, crêpes, waffles, eggs, and omelettes — the kind of high-carbohydrate morning meal that touring cyclists appreciate before a big day on the road. A patio is available for outdoor dining, and takeout and delivery are also offered.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Cora Breakfast and Lunch franchise located at Orchard Park Shopping Centre, 530-2271 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna, BC — matching OSM address and phone exactly. Services listed on the website include Dining room, Delivery, Take-out, Meeting room, and Patio, corroborating OSM tags for takeaway=yes and outdoor_seating=yes. No bike-specific amenities (rack, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those are left null.
concerns: Website address shows unit prefix '530-2271 Harvey Avenue' while OSM address field omits the unit prefix (unit is stored separately as addr:unit=530); minor formatting difference only, not a substantive discrepancy.
